Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to common tag and title questions.

Do I need an appointment?

No. Walk-ins are welcome Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM and Saturday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

How long does a visit take?

Most services are completed in about 10 minutes on average.

What do I need for a Maryland title transfer?

Bring your driver's license, the vehicle title, a lien release if applicable, a vehicle inspection and proof of insurance.

How long do new Maryland residents have to register?

You must register within 60 days of moving to Maryland. Delaying may result in loss of tax credit and a citation.

What if my title is held by a lienholder?

Provide your lienholder's fax number. We'll request the title on your behalf and contact you once it is received.

What should I do with my plates after moving out of Maryland?

Return the plates to the MVA before canceling your insurance to avoid a compulsory insurance violation.

Do you offer notary service?

Yes. Documents are notarized on the spot with no appointment. Bring a valid ID, the documents and all signers.

What languages do you speak?

Our team speaks English, Spanish and French.

Where are you located and where do I park?

We're at 201 N Frederick Ave, 2nd Floor, Gaithersburg, MD 20877. Parking is available; enter from the ramp.
